ASCII Art Text Banner

Turn any text into big ASCII art banners with a built-in 5×7 pixel font — copy it or download as a .txt file.


  

  

    
    
  

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Type your text (letters, numbers, basic punctuation).
  2. Pick a fill character and optional letter spacing.
  3. Preview the banner live.
  4. Copy it or download as a .txt file.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Which characters are supported?
A real 5×7 bitmap font is built into the tool covering A–Z, 0–9 and common punctuation. Letters you type are matched case-insensitively.
Does it work offline?
Yes — every glyph is drawn from pixel data, so it works fully offline in your browser.
How do I keep the alignment when sharing?
Use the plain-text download and paste it into a code editor or terminal with a monospace font for perfect alignment.
